newsitem.title: USA: International Multifoods forms distribution unit.
newsitem.headline: International Multifoods forms distribution unit.

text.p: International Multifoods Corp said Wednesday it created a single distribution business, combining its vending and limited-menu operations.
The company said this action will not have a material impact on fiscal 1998 results.

"This combination gives us the opportunity to realize significant synergies in the areas of logistics, warehousing and administration," Gary Costley, chairman, said in a statement. "We expect to see significant long-term financial benefits net of one-time charges, if any, resulting from this action."

The new business will combine VSA, the company's vending distribution business, and Multifoods Specialty Distribution, the limited-menu distribution business. The combined group had fiscal 1997 net sales of $1.8 billion.

"Our goal is to create a world-class distribution business," Costley said. "By blending our two distribution units, we will be better positioned to deliver profitable growth and enhance our cost-competitiveness."
The company named Jeffrey Boies as president of the new International Multifoods Distribution group.

VSA is a nationwide vending product distributor. Multifoods Specialty Distribution business is a national distributor of food and other products to operators of pizza and other limited-menu restaurants. Both units are currently headquartered in Denver.
The combined group employs about 2,200 people and has 33 distribution centers throughout the United States.
International Multifoods operates food manufacturing and foodservice distribution businesses in the United States, Canada and Venezuela.
